name: join-anti-existence
description: Measure anti-existence and post-join null filtering

queries.name: anti-sparse
queries.sql: SELECT a.user_id, a.tier FROM accounts a LEFT JOIN events e ON a.user_id = e.event_id WHERE e.event_id IS NULL ORDER BY a.user_id LIMIT 20

queries.name: anti-sparse-desc
queries.sql: SELECT a.user_id, a.country FROM accounts a LEFT JOIN events e ON a.user_id = e.event_id WHERE e.event_id IS NULL ORDER BY a.user_id DESC LIMIT 10

queries.name: semi-filter
queries.sql: SELECT e.event_id, a.tier FROM events e LEFT JOIN accounts a ON e.user_id = a.user_id WHERE a.user_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY e.event_id LIMIT 20
